messages.author: 49941758a6ca5715
messages.subject: eQTL analysis FDR adjustment
parts:
Hi,

 I would like to run an eQTL analysis using more than 20,000 genes as “phenotypic” traits, but I am struggling with the best procedure to account for the multiple tests across the many genes.

Following the posts here https://groups.google.com/g/rqtl2-disc/c/5SDLUI24J6c/m/mukbbx3JAAAJ I was wondering if we can use the output of the scan1() function as input to the qvalue package (although it is sometimes bigger than 1)? And using the resulting q-values as input for the scan1perm() function to obtain the significance eQTL peaks?

 Thanks, Jutta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: eQTL analysis FDR adjustment
parts:
I'd recommend using scan1perm() and getting a p-value (adjusting for the genome scan) for the biggest peak for each expression phenotype, and then using qvalue to control FDR across the phenotypes.

karl
